# Zorora Documentation

> Zorora is a local-deployment deep research engine that searches across academic databases, web sources, and newsroom articles, then synthesizes findings with credibility scoring and citation graphs. Built for macOS (Apple Silicon).

Documentation for Zorora is available at https://code.asoba.co

## Learn

- [Introduction](https://code.asoba.co/introduction): Overview of Zorora architecture, features, and local-first design
- [Architecture](https://code.asoba.co/technical-concepts/architecture): System architecture and component design
- [Research Pipeline](https://code.asoba.co/technical-concepts/research-pipeline): 6-phase deep research pipeline details
- [Storage](https://code.asoba.co/technical-concepts/storage): Local storage system (SQLite, JSON, FAISS)
- [Routing](https://code.asoba.co/technical-concepts/routing): Model routing and endpoint management
- [Credibility Scoring](https://code.asoba.co/technical-concepts/credibility-scoring): Multi-factor source credibility assessment

## Build

- [Quickstart](https://code.asoba.co/build/quickstart): Install and run your first query in 3 steps
- [Installation](https://code.asoba.co/guides/installation): Detailed installation methods
- [Configuration](https://code.asoba.co/guides/configuration): API keys, models, and endpoint configuration
- [Terminal REPL](https://code.asoba.co/guides/terminal-repl): Command-line interface guide
- [Web UI](https://code.asoba.co/guides/web-ui): Browser-based research interface
- [Research Workflow](https://code.asoba.co/guides/research-workflow): Deep research workflow guide
- [Code Generation](https://code.asoba.co/guides/code-generation): Codestral-powered code generation
- [Development Workflow](https://code.asoba.co/guides/development-workflow): Multi-step code development
- [Slash Commands](https://code.asoba.co/guides/slash-commands): Complete command reference
- [Nehanda v1](https://code.asoba.co/guides/nehanda-v1): Asoba's fine-tuned synthesis model
